title: JPCH Notification 2026 - Walk-in interview for 13 Senior Resident Posts
description: The Jag Pravesh Chandra Hospital (JPCH) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 13 Senior Resident Posts. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their MBBS, Post-graduation, PGDM, and DNB can apply for the JPCH Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can attend the walk-in interview.
